# GREEN18

> GREEN18 is an iPhone fantasy football live draft assistant that continuously recalculates player valuations according to league settings, roster construction, player availability, draft state, and user preferences.

## What GREEN18 is

GREEN18 is a deterministic draft model. The same league settings and the same
sequence of recorded picks always produce the same recommendation. Values are
computed from named components — league settings, current player value, and how
likely a player is to survive until the user's next pick — and the user always
makes the pick themselves.

## What GREEN18 is not

- It is NOT an AI, machine-learning, or large-language-model product, and it has no chat interface.
- It does NOT connect to, sync with, or import from any fantasy platform. It is an independent companion used alongside the platform where a league is hosted.
- It does NOT auto-draft or make selections. The user records picks and makes the decisions.
- It makes no forecast about the NFL season and no injury predictions.
- It requires no account and no sign-in. League and draft data stay on the device.

## Availability

iPhone only. Not currently available on Android.

GREEN18 is a paid app: a one-time purchase of US$9.99 on the App Store.
There is no subscription, no free tier, and no in-app purchases.

## Reference

- [How GREEN18 Values a Fantasy Player | GREEN18](https://green18.app/how-green18-ranks-fantasy-players): GREEN18 recalculates a player’s situational draft value from baseline value, league scoring, scarcity, availability pressure, roster fit and pick horizon.
- [Why Fantasy Rankings Change During a Draft | GREEN18](https://green18.app/why-fantasy-rankings-change-during-a-draft): Drafting removes alternatives. Every pick changes scarcity, replacement quality, roster need and opportunity cost — so the correct ranking changes with it.
- [Fantasy Draft Glossary | GREEN18](https://green18.app/glossary): Plain-language definitions of the fantasy draft terms that actually govern decisions: scarcity, replacement value, pick horizon, tiers, formats and more.
- [GREEN18 Methodology | Inputs, Determinism and Limits](https://green18.app/methodology): How GREEN18 arrives at a number: open football data, your league settings and your recorded picks, computed deterministically — and what the model cannot do.
- [The Science of Draft-State Valuation | GREEN18](https://green18.app/draft-science): How these ideas — scarcity, replacement, horizon, tiers, roster, format — compose into a single valuation of a player at one pick.
- [Fantasy Draft Scenarios | GREEN18](https://green18.app/scenarios): Twenty in-draft situations answered as conditions, not commands: runs, roster state, draft position and the endgame, each with the variable that decides it.
- [Fantasy Football League Formats | GREEN18](https://green18.app/formats): How scoring rules and roster requirements change what a fantasy player is worth, and why format is a valuation input rather than a detail.

## Draft Science

- [Draft-State Valuation (DSV) Explained | GREEN18](https://green18.app/draft-science/draft-state-valuation): Draft-State Valuation values a fantasy player by the current state of a specific draft rather than by a fixed preseason rank. The five state components, defined.
- [Positional Scarcity: A Precise Definition | GREEN18](https://green18.app/draft-science/positional-scarcity): Positional scarcity is a rate of decline, not a ranking of positions. How scarcity is defined, why it is not the same as value, and how it changes mid-draft.
- [Replacement Value in a Fantasy Draft | GREEN18](https://green18.app/draft-science/replacement-value): Replacement value is the quality of the player you can probably still get later. Why that gap decides picks better than the gap between two adjacent names on a list.
- [Opportunity Cost in a Fantasy Draft | GREEN18](https://green18.app/draft-science/opportunity-cost): What a pick actually costs: a scarce position, a falling value, duplicated roster strength, lost flexibility, a weaker future pick. The five costs, defined.
- [Pick Horizon: Why the Turn Changes Everything | GREEN18](https://green18.app/draft-science/pick-horizon): Distance to your next selection is a valuation input, not a scheduling detail. Why pick 3 and pick 10 produce different correct picks from an identical board.
- [Player Tier Collapse in a Fantasy Draft | GREEN18](https://green18.app/draft-science/player-tier-collapse): Why the last player in a fantasy tier is worth more than his rank suggests, and what happens to every remaining player once that tier empties.
- [Roster Construction and Fantasy Draft Value | GREEN18](https://green18.app/draft-science/roster-construction): How the players you already drafted change what the next player is worth to you — positional balance, flexibility, and why two managers should not share one board.
- [Why Superflex Reprices Quarterbacks | GREEN18](https://green18.app/draft-science/superflex-quarterback-value): Superflex re-prices quarterbacks structurally, not cosmetically: more starting slots than viable starters moves replacement level for the whole position.

## Formats

- [Superflex Format Explained | GREEN18](https://green18.app/formats/superflex): What the Superflex roster rule is, how it differs from 2QB and standard flex, and how one extra eligible slot reorders every position on the draft board.
- [PPR Scoring: How Receptions Reprice a Draft | GREEN18](https://green18.app/formats/ppr): What PPR scoring is, why a point per catch reorders players within positions rather than lifting everyone, and how it moves replacement level for skill players.
- [Standard Scoring Explained: Drafting Without PPR | GREEN18](https://green18.app/formats/standard): What standard fantasy scoring is, why removing reception points concentrates value in touchdowns and workload, and how that reshapes the draft board.

## Draft Scenarios

- [A Quarterback Run Just Started in Superflex | GREEN18](https://green18.app/scenarios/superflex-quarterback-run): A superflex quarterback run has begun. How to tell whether joining it is correct, using replacement quality, pick horizon and the number of starting slots left.
- [Five Running Backs Just Went in a Row | GREEN18](https://green18.app/scenarios/five-running-backs-go-in-a-row): A run cleared the running backs off the board. How to work out whether the position actually got scarcer, or whether the room simply moved together.
- [Quarterbacks Are Falling in My Superflex Draft | GREEN18](https://green18.app/scenarios/quarterbacks-falling-in-superflex): Nobody in your superflex league is drafting quarterbacks. How to tell whether the room is misvaluing the position, and when to be the manager who corrects it.
- [An Elite Tight End Just Fell to Me | GREEN18](https://green18.app/scenarios/elite-tight-end-falls): A top tight end slipped past his expected pick. How to value a positional edge honestly: against the tight end you would otherwise start, not the whole field.
- [I Already Have Two Wide Receivers | GREEN18](https://green18.app/scenarios/already-have-two-wide-receivers): Does owning two starters at a position lower the value of a third? How roster fit, flexible starting slots and bench value actually change the calculation.
- [Is an Early Draft Pick Better Than a Late One? | GREEN18](https://green18.app/scenarios/pick-three-vs-pick-ten): Drawing an early or a late slot changes the shape of your draft, not its quality. How pick horizon, tier timing and the turn decide which slot suits which board.
- [I Started My Draft Without a Running Back | GREEN18](https://green18.app/scenarios/rb-zero-start): Skipping a position early is a bet on the board, not a strategy that survives on its own. How to tell whether the bet is still paying and when to abandon it.
- [How Long Can I Wait to Draft a Quarterback? | GREEN18](https://green18.app/scenarios/waiting-on-quarterback): The answer is not a round number. How to convert “can I wait” into a survival question about the tier you intend to draft from, and read the answer live.
- [The Last Player in a Tier Is on the Board | GREEN18](https://green18.app/scenarios/last-player-in-a-tier): A tier is about to close. How to check whether the boundary is real, whether it will survive to your next pick, and what a genuine boundary is worth.
- [How to Draft Back-to-Back Picks at the Turn | GREEN18](https://green18.app/scenarios/drafting-from-the-turn): Two adjacent picks are one decision, not two. How to plan a pair at the turn, straddle a closing tier, and survive the long wait that follows.
- [Best Player Available or Roster Need? | GREEN18](https://green18.app/scenarios/best-player-available-vs-roster-need): Best available describes a ranking; need describes your roster. What actually reconciles them is margin over replacement — and when the two genuinely conflict.
- [A Player Fell Past Where You Expected | GREEN18](https://green18.app/scenarios/a-player-falls-past-his-expected-draft-position): A player is still on the board well past his expected draft position. What the fall does and does not tell you, and when the discount is worth taking.
- [Two Players You Value Almost Identically | GREEN18](https://green18.app/scenarios/choosing-between-two-similar-players): When two players grade out the same, the decision moves off the players. The tie-breakers that matter: replacement slope, availability, roster fit, horizon.
- [When Should You Draft a Kicker and Defense? | GREEN18](https://green18.app/scenarios/when-to-draft-a-kicker-and-defense): Why the advice to wait on kicker and defense is usually right, stated as margin over replacement rather than a slogan — and the conditions that reverse it.
- [Still No Tight End Late in the Draft | GREEN18](https://green18.app/scenarios/still-no-tight-end-in-the-late-rounds): An unfilled slot late in a draft is only urgent if the players left at that position differ from each other. How to test whether the gap you fear is real.
- [Two of My Starters Share a Bye Week | GREEN18](https://green18.app/scenarios/two-starters-share-a-bye-week): A shared bye week is a real but bounded cost, and mostly a roster-management problem. When it should move a draft pick and when it is an overcorrection.
- [Should I Draft My Own Running Back’s Backup? | GREEN18](https://green18.app/scenarios/drafting-a-backup-for-your-own-running-back): Drafting the backup behind your own starter is insurance with a price. How workload concentration and the pick you would otherwise spend decide it.
- [My Draft Timer Ran Out — What Now? | GREEN18](https://green18.app/scenarios/you-missed-your-pick): A pick you did not choose changes your roster, not your method. How to re-evaluate from the state you are actually in instead of trying to undo it.
- [Should I Draft an Unproven Player or a Proven One? | GREEN18](https://green18.app/scenarios/a-rookie-or-a-proven-veteran): Unproven versus established is a variance decision, not a talent decision. How the roster slot and its alternative decide whether a wider range is worth paying for.
- [How to Use the Last Rounds of a Draft | GREEN18](https://green18.app/scenarios/how-to-use-the-final-rounds): In the final rounds every remaining player is near replacement level, which makes upside cheap and "best available" a rule that stops working. What to do instead.

## Tools

- [Positional Scarcity Calculator | GREEN18](https://green18.app/tools/scarcity-calculator): Estimate whether a position is scarce enough to take now, from your league size, starting slots, players already drafted, and the gap to your next pick.
- [Pick Horizon Calculator for Snake Drafts | GREEN18](https://green18.app/tools/pick-horizon-calculator): Work out how many players come off the board before your next turn in a snake draft, and what that distance means for the pick you are making now.
- [Replacement Level Calculator by League Size | GREEN18](https://green18.app/tools/league-value-calculator): Find the replacement baseline at any position for your league size and starting lineup, and see why that line decides what a player is actually worth.
- [Superflex Quarterback Demand Calculator | GREEN18](https://green18.app/tools/superflex-qb-demand-calculator): See how many starting quarterback slots your Superflex league still has to fill, and why that number re-prices the position rather than just raising it.
- [PPR Value Adjustment Calculator | GREEN18](https://green18.app/tools/ppr-value-adjustment-calculator): See how many points a scoring format’s reception rule adds to a player’s season, and why that changes the order of your board rather than just the numbers.
